quickEntry.title: Quick entry
quickEntry.description: Type it the way you’d say it. Parsed on this device — nothing is sent anywhere.

status.off: Data stored only on this device

sync.point1: Your data is encrypted on this device before it is uploaded. The server only stores unreadable bytes.
sync.point2: Encryption keys come from a passphrase that never leaves your device.
sync.point3: No account or email. Another device joins with a link or QR code plus the passphrase.
sync.createBody: Choose a long passphrase — four or more random words work well.

strength.hint: Use at least 12 characters; several unrelated words are best.

sync.rememberHint: Keeps a non-exportable key in this browser so you do not retype the passphrase.
sync.lossWarning: If you lose the passphrase, the synced data cannot be recovered — not even by us.
sync.understood: I understand and saved my passphrase somewhere safe.
sync.joinBody: Paste the link from your other device (or scan its QR code), then type the passphrase.
sync.vaultLinkHint: The link or the vault ID.
sync.joinMergeNote: Data already on this device is merged with the vault; nothing is lost.
sync.lockedBody: This device is linked to a vault but does not remember the key. Enter the passphrase to resume syncing.
sync.pairBody: Scan this QR code or open the link on the other device, then enter the passphrase there.
sync.pairPrivacy: The vault ID and salt travel after the # of the link, which browsers never send to servers. Neither is secret without the passphrase.
sync.qrAlt: QR code with the link to join this vault
sync.disconnectBody: Your data stays on this device and on the server. You can join again with the passphrase.
sync.deleteTitle: Delete the encrypted vault from the server?
sync.deleteBody: Other devices will stop syncing. Data on each device is kept.
sync.demoDisabled: Sync is turned off in demo mode. Start fresh to use it with your own data.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_link: This does not look like a Fluxo vault link.
errors.vault_missing: This vault no longer exists on the server.
errors.unauthorized: The server no longer accepts this key. Join the vault again.
errors.too_large: Your data is larger than the 5 MB sync limit.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Sync will try again shortly.
errors.server: The server had a problem. Sync will try again.
errors.decryption: The vault could not be decrypted with this key.

demo.bannerHint: Sample data, kept apart from your own.

landing.title: Your money, in flow. Your data, at home.
landing.subtitle: A calm, precise personal finance organizer that runs entirely in your browser. No account, no tracking — your financial data never leaves your device.
landing.trust: Free and open source · Works offline · English and Portuguese

preview.perDay: per day · 18 days left this month

landing.pillarsTitle: Built so your finances stay yours.

local.title: Stays on your device
local.body: Everything is stored in your browser’s IndexedDB. There is no server copy unless you turn on sync.

noAccount.title: No account, no email
noAccount.body: Open it and start. Nobody — including us — knows who you are or what you spend.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: Install it as an app on your phone or computer. It keeps working without a connection.

sync.title: Encrypted sync, if you want
sync.body: Sync devices through a vault that only ever holds ciphertext. The key comes from your passphrase.

cards.title: Credit cards, the Brazilian way
cards.body: Closing and due days, installments that land on the right invoice, partial payments and the limit you really have left.

safeToSpend.title: Safe to spend today
safeToSpend.body: Your balance minus what is still due this month, divided by the days left — with the full math one tap away.

forecast.title: 90-day forecast
forecast.body: See the days your balance would dip, from recurring bills, installments and invoice due dates.

quickEntry.title: Type it like you say it
quickEntry.body: “lunch 32.50 yesterday nubank” becomes a transaction, parsed locally in English or Portuguese.

import.title: Imports that learn
import.body: OFX and CSV statements with duplicate detection. Fix a category once and Fluxo remembers it.

budgets.title: Budgets, goals and reports
budgets.body: Alerts at 80% and 100%, rollover, goal forecasts and a Sankey of where the money went.

landing.syncBody: Sync is optional. When you turn it on, the server stores a single encrypted blob it cannot read.

device.title: Your passphrase stays here
device.body: Keys are derived on your device with PBKDF2 (600,000 rounds) and HKDF. The passphrase is never sent.

cipher.title: Data is encrypted first
cipher.body: A snapshot is compressed and sealed with AES-GCM before it leaves the browser.

server.title: The server sees only noise
server.body: It keeps ciphertext, its size and a version number — plus a hash of your access token, never the token.

landing.ctaBody: The demo loads six months of sample data, kept apart from your own.
landing.footer: Fluxo · MIT licensed · made by Luciano Pereira

notFound.title: This page wandered off
notFound.body: The link may be broken, or the page was moved.

overview.perDay_other: per day · {{count}} days left this month
overview.tapForDetails: Tap to see how this is calculated

overview.breakdownBody: Your checking and wallet balances, minus what is still due this month, split across the days left.
overview.forecastLabel: Projected balance for the next 90 days
overview.noUpcoming: Nothing due in the next 30 days

empty.title: Let’s set up your first account

transactions.billPaymentHint: Sending money to a card pays its invoice.
transactions.needAccount: Add an account or a card first.

empty.title: No accounts yet

cards.title: Credit cards
cards.name: Name

cards.partialHint: Partial payments are fine; the rest stays on the invoice.
cards.deleteBody: Its purchases stay in your history.

empty.title: No cards yet

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.subtitle: Monthly limits per category. Alerts at 80% and when you go over.
budgets.rolloverHint: Money not spent this month is added to next month’s limit.
budgets.duplicate: This category already has a budget.

empty.title: No budgets yet
empty.body: Set a monthly limit for the categories you want to keep an eye on.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.subtitle: Bills and income that repeat. They become real transactions on their date.
recurring.editorHint: Each occurrence is recorded automatically when its day arrives.
recurring.dayHint: Short months use their last day.
recurring.activeHint: Paused items are not recorded or forecast.

empty.title: Nothing recurring yet
empty.body: Add rent, salary, subscriptions — they feed the forecast and “safe to spend”.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.lead: Short version: your financial data never leaves your device unless you turn on encrypted sync — and even then, nobody but you can read it.

local.title: Stored on your device
local.body: Accounts, transactions and everything else live in your browser’s IndexedDB. There is no account to create and no login.

noAccount.title: No account, no profile
noAccount.body: Fluxo does not know who you are. There is no email, no password and no user database.

sync.title: Optional end-to-end encrypted sync
sync.body: If you enable sync, your data is encrypted on your device with a key derived from your passphrase before it is uploaded. The passphrase never leaves your device.

server.title: What the server sees
server.body: Only an opaque encrypted blob, its size, a version number and timestamps. It cannot decrypt the contents, and it stores only a hash of your access token.

analytics.title: No tracking
analytics.body: No analytics, no ads, no third-party scripts and no cookies.

control.title: You are in control
control.body: Export a full backup at any time, delete everything from Settings, or delete your sync vault from the server.

goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Save toward what matters, with a forecast of when you will get there.
goals.name: Name
goals.monthlyHint: Planned amount per month. It is reserved in “safe to spend”.
goals.paceHistory: Forecast based on your last 3 months of contributions.
goals.pacePlan: Forecast based on your planned monthly contribution.

empty.title: No goals yet
empty.body: An emergency fund, a trip, a new laptop — set a target and Fluxo forecasts the date.

sankey.title: Where the money went
sankey.label: Flow from income categories to expense categories

empty.title: Not enough data yet
empty.body: Reports appear once you have income or expenses in the period.

settings.title: Settings
settings.currencyHint: Amounts are stored as-is; this only changes how they are shown.
settings.syncDescription: Optional, end-to-end encrypted sync between your devices.

rules.empty: No rules yet. Fix a category after an import and Fluxo will remember it.

data.wipeConfirm: Export a backup first if you might need this data again.
